verdict: CLAUDE wins GW5 on every axis that survives scrutiny. Raw numbers: CLAUDE 69.35 > YOU 62.05, with Gemini nominally 53.74 (self-reported) or 75.44 (recomputed). Gemini's 75.44 is the highest figure on the board and must be discarded anyway, for two independent reasons: (1) the plan is not executable — selling Konsa 4.5 plus 0.7 bank funds 5.2m against Gvardiol's 5.7m, a 0.5m shortfall, so the whole XI it scores is fictional; (2) it captains a defender the squad does not own off a single-week xpts spike, which breaks the locked APEX captaincy rule (season cum_pts leader among nailed premiums) that seven holdout rounds established. Strip the illegal transfer out and Gemini's plan collapses below CLAUDE's. ENGINES DISAGREE — but the disagreement resolves cleanly in CLAUDE's favour. On the three direct questions: (a) YES, Haaland is the correct GW5 captain — he is the season cum_pts leader (33 pts, 8.25 ppg, 100% mins, AVAILABLE) and uniquely wins cap_score (8.01 vs Palmer 6.09), Monte-Carlo EV (14.75 vs 10.04), floor p10 (7.97 vs 4.51) and p_blank (1.4% vs 7.5%) at the same time, at home vs Sunderland who carry the worst opponent rating in the pool; intel measures the current Palmer armband as a ~56% EO short worth about -4.6 xPts to the field and -10 to -18 rank-adjusted on a Haaland haul. (b) YES, the vice-captain must move off João Pedro — medical-bay has UPGRADED him from 75% doubtful to confirmed OUT (knee edema / ACL-MCL sprain vs Hull 12 Sep, Alonso confirms he misses Friday vs Brentford, return ~GW7). A vice who cannot play is a null armband, and with BB/WC/TC all spent there is no chip left to rescue a zeroed captaincy. Move VC to Saka (or to Haaland if Haaland is not taking the armband). (c) The real squad does NOT already match the best plan — it needs four moves, not zero. Beyond the armband: João Pedro must come out of the XI entirely (dead 2.70 slot), Egan (5.37) should replace Ajer (3.10) for +2.27 free, and the free transfer Ajer->Bogle converts a benched FDR-4 enabler into the 3rd-highest xpts asset in the pool while Bogle's price rise is still pending tonight. Chip call is unanimous and correct: SAVE.
highest_leverage_action: Move the armband from Palmer to Haaland, and in the same edit move the vice from João Pedro (confirmed OUT) to Saka. This is one screen, costs 0 transfers and 0 points, is worth +2.32 xPts on raw projection and roughly -4.6 to -18 in rank-adjusted terms against a field that is ~58% captained on Haaland, and it simultaneously removes the catastrophic tail where Palmer is a late absentee and the captaincy falls to a player who is already ruled out. Everything else this week — Egan for Ajer, the Ajer->Bogle transfer, benching João Pedro — is worth less than this single fix.
